tasks.label: 2. Запуск Backend (JVM Server)
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $env:JAVA_OPTS='-Xms512m -Xmx2g'; $env:HH_REFERENCE_WORKERS='4'; $env:HH_COMPACT_OBSERVER='1'; & '${workspaceFolder}/colony-dsl-parser/gradlew.bat' -p colony-dsl-parser installDist; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Backend build failed.' }; & '${workspaceFolder}/colony-dsl-parser/build/install/colony-dsl-parser/bin/colony-dsl-parser.bat' serve examples/physics/settlement-5000.json 8080

tasks.label: 2a. Запустить ecosystem-small на Native VM
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; & cmake -S native -B native/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Native VM configure failed.' }; & cmake --build native/build --config Release; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Native VM build failed.' }; $env:JAVA_OPTS='-Xms512m -Xmx2g'; $env:HH_NATIVE_WORKERS='4'; $env:HH_COMPACT_OBSERVER='1'; & '${workspaceFolder}/colony-dsl-parser/gradlew.bat' -p colony-dsl-parser installDist; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Backend build failed.' }; & '${workspaceFolder}/colony-dsl-parser/build/install/colony-dsl-parser/bin/colony-dsl-parser.bat' serve-native examples/physics/ecosystem-small.json 8080

tasks.label: Сборка C++ Native VM (CMake)
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; & cmake -S native -B native/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Native VM configure failed.' }; & cmake --build native/build --config Release; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Native VM build failed.' }
